per_placement.method: observed: inverse-variance mean over the five days, se widened by sqrt(chi2/nu) when chi2/nu > 1 (nu = 4); binomial sigmas are half-widths of the quasi-likelihood 68% profile intervals. observed_plain: plain mean over the five days, se = sd / sqrt(5). predicted: plain mean over the five days of the model's prediction (each job's measured f), fitted with the same estimator. ratio = observed_plain / predicted_mean, so both sides are averaged alike; its se carries the observed error only. Lambda is pooled from the daily ratios (inverse-variance). The t test is within one placement (nu = 4); there is no test across placements.

placements_compared.note: The difference between the placements is descriptive: on every day these were the only usable distance-5 placements, and they overlap.

prespecified.source: runs/combined.json (pooled_x), the prespecified code at v0.2.0
prespecified.note: The prespecified summary value, quoted in the paper's results and abstract; the rule treats the ten repetitions as independent, which they are not.
